CURRENT QUESTION:
share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH donor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    Donor,
    COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS receipt_count,
    SUM(Amount) AS total_amount
  FROM donations
  GROUP BY Donor
),
classified_donors AS (
  SELECT
    Donor,
    CASE WHEN receipt_count > 1 THEN 'Repeat' ELSE 'One-time' END AS donor_type,
    total_amount
  FROM donor_counts
)
SELECT
  donor_type,
  SUM(total_amount) AS total_amount,
  ROUND(SUM(total_amount) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(total_amount)) OVER (), 0), 2) AS share_percent,
  COUNT(DISTINCT Donor) AS donor_count
FROM classified_donors
GROUP BY donor_type
ORDER BY donor_type;
```
